recommended.title: A configured catalog with nothing usable does not look empty
recommended.acceptance: The user-facing catalog path preserves the distinction the port now makes between no_records_usable and catalog_empty. apps/web/src/lib/catalog.ts maps an empty array to 'empty' and therefore COLLAPSES THE TWO, which is the one place PL-0305's four-state work stops short of the user. The two states have different causes and different remedies: catalog_empty means the source has nothing, while no_records_usable means records exist and every one of them was withheld -- almost always for want of an operator rights basis, which is an operator action rather than a user problem. Required: catalog.ts consumes describeCatalog through requireCatalogDescription rather than inferring state from an empty array; a source that does not implement describeCatalog still works and is not reported as a failure, because the method is optional on the port by design; the user-facing copy for the withheld case does NOT promise the content is coming, since nobody has committed to obtaining those rights; and the withheld reasons are not leaked verbatim to the user, because they name internal policy vocabulary. A regression must drive both states through the real loader and observe different answers.
